_note: Deployment defaults for scripts/deploy-intelligence.mjs (and CI). No secrets here — secrets live in Cloudflare/GitHub only. CLI flags override these values. project_name is a NEW direct-upload project: the original vitaflex-monte-wo project is git-connected and rejects direct upload; the old site keeps serving there until you choose to switch. account_id is public (dashboard URL) and lets wrangler skip /memberships, which API tokens often lack. access_issuer/access_aud are PUBLIC values (team domain + application id), not secrets.
